name: time-travel
title: Rewind a run, edit its state, and branch

origin.source: Event-log replay of a prefix, an edited persisted snapshot, and a resume on a new thread

comparison.purpose: Replays a finished thread's log up to the outline, edits the tone on that snapshot, and resumes it as a new thread that redrafts in the new tone, where LangGraph uses get_state_history to pick a checkpoint and update_state to edit it.

runners.label: Run formal, then branch playful from the outline
